senses.gloss:
अब्धि m. (-ब्धिः) The ocean.
 E. अब् substituted for अप् water; धि from धा
to have, and कि aff.

अब्धिकफ m. (-फः) Cuttlefish bone.
 E. अब्धि, and कफ phlegm; being
considered as the froth of the sea.

अब्धिज m. du. (-जौ) The two sons of SŪRYA, and physicians of Svarga.
f. (-जा) Wine.
 E. अब्धि, and ज born: the former are more usually
termed the sons of AŚVINĪ, see आश्विनेय.

अब्धिद्वीपा f. (-पा) The earth.
 E. अब्धि, and द्वीप in the fem. form; an island
surrounded by the ocean.

अब्धिनगरी f. (-री) A name of Dvārakā, the capital of KṚṢṆA, see
द्वारका.
 E. अब्धि, and नगरी a city: the ocean-city.

अब्धिमण्डूकी f. (-की) A pearl oyster.
 E. अब्धि the ocean, and मण्डूकी a female
frog.

अब्धिशयन m. (-नः) A name of VIṢṆU.
 E. अब्धि, and शयन sleeping;
sleeping on the ocean at the periods of the destruction and renova-
tion of the world, having the serpent ANANTA for his couch.

अब्ध्यग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Submarine fire.
 E. अब्धि, and अग्नि fire. See और्व्वस्.
